reviews.title: Uneven bows
reviews.review_text: I had to order one curtain from another store as they only had one from the store I bought it from. After washing and ironing I hung them up. That's when I noticed the bow/tie back on them were uneven. There is about an inch difference between the curtains and on one there is like a quarter inch between the bows. They are very nice looking curtains though.
